record.question: The capacity of a metal to exhibit considerable elastic recovery upon release of load is known as
record.explanation: Printed page 5 confirms the stem and all four supplied options. Elastic recovery on unloading describes elasticity (and recoverable elastic strain energy is associated with resilience); neither is offered. Stiffness is resistance to deformation, creep is time-dependent deformation, fatigue concerns repeated loading, and impact strength concerns sudden loading, so no supplied option is defensible; the item needs corrected options.
